full_page.content:
1935, May
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 344 Cont.
May 5th James Lenny - 4 - double mastoids in January last yr. Measles last March ... now threatened with mastoid operation again.
Rose McBride - 38 - bruised breast was thought to be cancerous but seems less threatening .....
(her mother) Mary O'Herron - 62 - pronounced dead a year ago in April - prayers asked in Church for repose of her soul ... Enrolled in Ser. Mass Ass'n and recovered ... Now again expected to pass a- way any day .... Happy death or .... 10 child'n.
Page 345
May 5 Mary M. Glaser - 78 - heart giving was Enrolled (May 3) day before yesterday when given up. Reported To-night "Coming O.K." Said to be miracle - May 6 had turn +
6 Mrs. Mary Kaltz - 65 - completely helpless - swolen joints - always in pain. 4 yrs. n ..
James Ward - 31 - Epileptic spells ... every 2-3 weeks.
6 Peter Fr. Brinkman - 4 - mastoid
Garland without house ...
Sidney Corbett - 43 - once Episcopelian - now totally without re- ligion or faith.
8 G. VanBuren - coming 3 - scarlet Fever
8 Anderson MacDonald - 45 - Episcop ..... heart ... on way to Gr. Hosp ....
8 Cath. E. Tieman - 13 - mentally weak Garland ....
Page 346 May 8 Paul Nestor - on parol ... trying Andrew Sullivan - 52 - Eyes ... Sam Remer - Jewish very sick -
Mary Dickson - 47 - quite a goiter - fears operation.
